Hana: quick follow-up from runtime section — tiny checklist for roadmap doc: 

- microbatch defaults (chat vs embeddings)
- KV cache semantics and eviction policy
- who runs kernel canaries and rollback authority?
- minimal telemetry widgets for PMs

Victor: Answers from runtime lead, quick bullets:
- microbatch: chat routes default max_batch=8 (low-latency); bulk/embeddings default 64 or 128 for throughput. We allow route-level overrides.
- KV cache: per-session pin 2-5m then shared prefix cache. Eviction = TTL (default 30m) + size-based LRU. Not a source of truth.
- kernel canaries: runtime eng schedules canaries, SRE owns emergency rollback; normal rollback decision is automated when error rate >1% or sustained latency breach.
- telemetry: give PMs one dashboard: p50/p95 token-latency, request success rate, and cost per 1k tokens. Optional: model-variant traffic split.

Leah: perf numbers from last staging run (gpu-pool-delta, single-token continues):
- chat batch=8 -> p50 12ms, p95 46ms, p99 160ms
- chat batch=16 -> p50 17ms, p95 78ms, p99 300ms
- embeddings batch=128 -> p50 220ms, p95 720ms
Note: batch=64 memory spike observed on older nodes; mitigated by kernel watermarks.

Rory: Canary playbook link: https://confluence.redwood.ai/playbooks/kernel-canary (has steps for partial drain, tracing, and rollback contacts). We'll add a short runbook snippet to the roadmap doc.

OpsBot: Canary created: canary/2234567890 scheduled 2026-04-10T16:00:00Z. Alerts: runtime-canary-latency, runtime-canary-errors.

Hana: Victor, can you drop a minimal config snippet? Leah, paste the staging dashboard link? I'll compile into the all-hands notes.

Victor: Minimal canary snippet:
```
canary:
  fraction: 0.05
  duration_minutes: 30
  fallback_policy:
    latency_ms: 500
    window_s: 30
    fallback_variant: quantized-v1
```

Leah: Staging dashboard: https://dashboards.redwood.ai/d/delta/runtime-batching-staging (includes histograms + memory traces).

Hana: perfect. please add any representative prompts for prewarm here (1 short convo, 1 long context ~1500 tokens, 1 embedding batch).

Victor: short: "Explain recursion in one sentence." long: repeated policy doc ~1500 tokens. embeddings: 128 small JSON docs.

Leah: I'll kick the canary and post raw histograms in this thread. Closing follow-up for now. :white_check_mark:
